question.problem:
Find the solution $y(t)$ given that the Laplace transform of the initial value problem

$$
{y}^{″}(t)+3{y}^{′}(t)+2y(t)={u}_{2}(t),\,y(0)=0,\,{y}^{′}(0)=0,
$$

is given by

$$
{s}^{2}Y(s)+3sY(s)+2Y(s)=\frac{{e}^{-2s}}{s}.
$$

The solution is $y(t)=u(t-2)\cdot (\frac{1}{2}-{e}^{-(t-2)}\,+\,$
{{field-1}}
$).$
